daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling sharp and curious. There's this underlying restlessness asking you to try something new—lean into it. Your vibe today is all about breaking your own patterns and seeing what happens.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your person might be picking up on some shift in your energy. Don't overthink it—just be real about what you're feeling. Single? Someone's noticing your authenticity today. That's your real power.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is literally your superpower rn. That project or task everyone's been avoiding? You're the one who can actually nail it. Trust your instincts on what needs tweaking. Your efforts won't go unnoticed.
daily.health: Your body's asking for something different—maybe a new workout, a different meal vibe, or just moving in ways that feel good instead of obligatory. Listen to that. Rest when you need it; your energy cycles matter.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to release perfectionism and embrace the beautiful mess of being human. Mercury's vibes are helping you communicate what's been stuck in your throat. Trust the unfolding.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or single, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Stop overthinking those texts and let yourself feel without analyzing. Someone's noticing your realness, and that's what magnetizes connection.
weekly.career: Your organizational skills are about to shine, but the real magic happens when you collaborate instead of controlling every detail. Let others surprise you with their approaches. Innovation loves a shared workspace.
weekly.health: Your body's asking you to slow down and actually listen to what it needs. Move in ways that feel good, not punishing. Hydration and sleep are your quiet power moves this week—treat them like non-negotiable rituals.
